name: gaotus-appforge-mvp
description: Gaotus AppForge master wrapper and verified Android build factory

scripts.native:init: npm run generate && npx cap add android && npx cap add ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs all && node scripts/apply-origin-policy.mjs
scripts.android:debug: npm run generate && npx cap sync android && npm run android:runtime && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run generate && npx cap sync android && npm run android:runtime && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:sync: npm run generate && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs ios
